info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, swellAngle, radians, Ypos, mapXPos, survivorDelay, thisMember, startMember, Xvel, cableGuy, survivorState, ThisWidth, thisHalfHeight, grabCount, distToHQ, targetSprite, targetOffset, frameDir, loopWidth, loopXglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gCableItem, gCableLength, gRescueCount, gRescuedList, gScoreon getPropertyDescriptionList me  descriptionList = [:]  addProp(descriptionList, #targetSprite, [#default: 1, #format: #sprite, #comment: "targetSprite"])  addProp(descriptionList, #targetOffset, [#default: point(0, 0), #format: #point, #comment: "offSet from targetSprite"])  return descriptionListendon beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  startMember = this.memberNum  thisMember = random(3) + startMember - 1  this.member = member(thisMember, "Gfx")  loopWidth = gTileIDList.count * 128  loopX = gTileIDList.count * 128 * 0.5  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  this.locZ = 60  Xvel = 0  mapXPos = Xpos - 256 - 64  survivorDelay = 0  swellAngle = 0  cableGuy = sprite(6)  survivorState = #ONGROUND  ThisWidth = this.width  thisHalfHeight = this.height / 2  grabCount = 0  distToHQ = 0  frameDir = 1endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    case survivorState of      #ONGROUND:        if targetSprite = this.spriteNum then          Xpos = Xpos + (gXVel + gXOffset)          this.locH = Xpos          if Xpos > loopX then            Xpos = Xpos - loopWidth          end if          if Xpos < -loopX then            Xpos = Xpos + loopWidth          end if        else          this.loc = sprite(targetSprite).loc + targetOffset        end if        survivorDelay = survivorDelay + 1        if survivorDelay >= 5 then          survivorDelay = 0          if ((thisMember + frameDir) > (startMember + 2)) or ((thisMember + frameDir) < startMember) then            frameDir = -frameDir          end if          thisMember = thisMember + frameDir          this.member = member(thisMember, "Gfx")          diffX = abs(this.locH - cableGuy.locH)          diffY = abs(this.locV - cableGuy.locV)          if (diffX < ThisWidth) and (diffY < thisHalfHeight) then            grabCount = grabCount + 1            if grabCount >= 2 then              if (gCableItem = 0) and (gCableLength >= 50) then                survivorState = #ONCABLE                puppetSound(4, member(63 + cableGuy.speechCounter, "Sfx"))                gCableItem = 1              end if            end if          else            grabCount = 0          end if        end if      #ONCABLE:        this.loc = cableGuy.loc        if gCableLength = 0 then          gCableItem = 0          survivorState = #INCOPTER          gRescueCount = gRescueCount + 1          gScore = gScore + 500          puppetSound(3, member(8, "Sfx"))          gRescuedList.add(this)        end if      #INCOPTER:        this.locH = -1000        this.locV = -1000      #GOTOHQ:        thisMember = thisMember + 1        if thisMember > (startMember + 2) then          thisMember = startMember        end if        this.member = member(thisMember, "Gfx")        if distToHQ <= 0 then          Xvel = 0          this.blend = this.blend - 5          if this.blend <= 0 then            survivorState = #HOME            gRescueCount = gRescueCount + 1            gScore = gScore + 1000            puppetSound(3, member(8, "Sfx"))          end if        end if        Xpos = Xpos + gXVel + gXOffset + Xvel        distToHQ = distToHQ + Xvel        Ypos = 270        this.locH = Xpos        this.locV = Ypos      #HOME:        this.locH = -1000        this.locV = -1000    end case  end ifend
